about_the_game:
This is the demo for the game, it includes the first temple and boss!

Super Star Adventure is the 1-bit RPG that takes you on a wild ride through deep space gone wrong. Your ship hits a meteor field above Astralis, a rogue planet full of weird tech, weirder ruins, and even weirder creatures.

Your mission? Scavenge your busted ship's parts. Simple? NO—because everything on Astralis is either broken, cursed, alive, or some combo of the three. You'll explore the planet, barter with shady foes, and maybe punch a Shardkin or two.

Combat’s tactical but snappy. Dialogue’s weird. The whole thing plays like a forgotten Game Boy cart someone modded to have feelings.
It’s lonely out there, but not quiet.

Features:

  • Active Turn-Based Combat – Engaging fights where timing is important!

  • Three Damage Types – Balance Physical, Energy, and Mind attacks to exploit enemy weaknesses.

  • Exploration-Focused Gameplay – Search open zones, solve light puzzles, and recover missing ship parts.

  • Customizable Loadouts – Swap characters and gear to suit your style.

  • Dialogue-Rich Story – Strange characters, cryptic lore, and choices that shape how you’re remembered.

  • Chiptune-Inspired Soundtrack – A moody, cosmic score sets the tone for your adventure.

  • Original 1-bit Visual Style – Crisp pixel art in stark contrast with strange alien designs.
